body:
Written on the back: “The two men from the crop trial left yellow dust on every chair. We felt dizzy before the county van came.”

The person beside me recognized the handwriting and went quiet. We had been told not to rely on yesterday’s directions.

The person who was supposed to collect it had no time to stop. I did not put it back with the rest of the ordinary papers.
title: Photograph after the matinee

body:
I wrote the closing time on the chalkboard. Later a man asked me to rub it out and say we had shut earlier.

The people at the last table were still here when he came in. One of them had gone to call a friend and left a coat behind. I did not know whether to give the coat back when the man took their names.

The board is clean. The coat is in the cupboard with my own things. If anyone comes for it, I will tell them when I last saw its owner.
title: The last table
